name: Strict Term-Dominance Certificate
statement: There are shared real row weights $\lambda_{p,i}$ for every minimal missing pattern $p$ and word-dependent real witness weights $w_i^c$ such that, for every concept $c$ and pattern $p$, the largest favorable term $\lambda_{p,i}+w_i^c$ is strictly larger than the largest unfavorable term.
hypotheses: Finite nonempty binary class; an empty unfavorable maximum is $-\infty$.
comments: The weights are logarithmic exponents shared across all concepts. This is stronger than ordinary feasibility of one separator array.
